claim_one_line: THE SCHEDULED SWEEP: 156 OF 277 ARE READABLE HERE, AND THE FIRST HIGH-VALUE ROW READ NEEDS A CORRECTION. docs/HARVEST_LEDGER.md carries 526 rows of which 277 are SCHEDULED -- more than half the ledger is harvested work no main text names. Of those, 156 ARE READABLE at their referenced commits (cloud 100, consolidation 30, codex 18, cc3-braver 5, audit 3) and 121 are not (physics 57, cc3 paper 41, hostile-review 12, SM-derivation 9), the latter living on branches absent from this repository; verification/readable_scheduled.json lists all 156 with seat, arc, claim, commit and path so the next sweep starts from a list. A PARSING TRAP REVERSED THE ANSWER ONCE AND IS RECORDED: the source field is `path` @ commit with the COMMIT REF OUTSIDE THE BACKTICKS, so a parser that splits the backtick content on ' @' finds no commit, falls back to HEAD and reports ZERO readable -- which is what the first pass here did and which would have produced exactly the wrong recommendation, that the backlog is a branch-access problem and cannot be verified on this bench; one manual git show contradicted it. THE FIRST HIGH-VALUE ROW READ, cloud memo 79 ONE_BIT_WITNESS, claims on the full radius-5 ball of 484 words that chi(w) = chi(w^-1) with zero exceptions and reads this as the 27-level shadow of the figure-eight's strong invertibility, concluding the chirality bit is character-invisible. THE COMPUTATION IS RIGHT AND THE ATTRIBUTION IS NOT: in SL2 every element is conjugate to its inverse, A and A^-1 having eigenvalues {L, 1/L}, so tr(A) = tr(A^-1) IDENTICALLY and chi_27 as a sum of Sym-power traces inherits it, with nothing about the figure-eight used. Verified on the geometric holonomy of m004, m003, m010 and s958, 120 random words each at 30 digits, max |tr(w) - tr(w^-1)| between 4.7e-48 and 1.0e-44 and max |chi_27(w) - chi_27(w^-1)| between 4.3e-43 and 1.1e-38 -- it holds on EVERY manifold because it is a fact about SL2 and not about any of them. The memo half-saw this, recording that its pre-registered non-vacuity gate REFUSED and calling the refusal the finding, which was right: a gate that cannot be satisfied is the signature of a test that cannot fail. THAT IS THE THIRD INSTANCE OF ONE FAILURE MODE across three independent seats -- B1297's pre-registered PASS/FAIL reported FORCED rather than FAIL because it could never have passed, THE PAPER's section 8 admitting its cyclic-tower test could not have passed once the two theorems were found, and memo 79's refused gate -- a pattern about how this programme designs tests that is worth more than any one of the three. It also CORROBORATES B1334 from the character side: B1334 proved I = 0 using only dimension counting and inversion symmetry, memo 79 shows the holonomy characters cannot see 27 vs 27bar on any manifold, two independent routes agreeing that the vanishing is not about the object being special.
